offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results; paid-plan pay-as-you-go credits cost $5 per increment (Hobby: 1,000 credits).
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；返回 titles、descriptions 和 URLs，可选附带每个结果的完整页面内容
offerings.note: 费用按结果数向上取整：1–10 个结果为 2 credits；搜索结果默认包含 Highlights。

offerings.name: Search — Anonymized ZDR
offerings.pricing: Cost: 2 credits per 10 results. Available on Enterprise plans via enterprise: ["anon"].
offerings.note: Firecrawl 侧全零数据保留；上游搜索提供商可能缓存查询，但查询会被完全匿名化。

offerings.name: Search — End-to-End ZDR
offerings.pricing: Cost: 10 credits per 10 results. Available on Enterprise plans via enterprise: ["zdr"].
offerings.note: Firecrawl 与上游搜索提供商均执行零数据保留；查询和结果数据不会在管道任何环节存储。
